# lila.events

Lila's event bus: call a function when the scene is saved, the selection or time changes, a mode switches, ...

```
from lila import events

def saved(e):
    print("saved", e["path"])

sub = events.subscribe("sceneSaved", saved)
events.unsubscribe(sub)
```

The handler gets a dict {"event", "path", "name", "node", "time"}; which fields mean something depends on the event. Subscriptions made while an extension loads belong to it and go when it unloads.

## names

```python
names()
```

Every event name.

## subscribe

```python
subscribe(event, fn, owner=None)
```

Call fn(data) on each `event` (see names()). Returns an id for unsubscribe.

## unsubscribe

```python
unsubscribe(id)
```

False when id is not subscribed.
